Defect in invoice net settlement calculation during checkout:
When generating customer invoices with fractional discounts, test_invoice_net_settlement_with_fractional_discount fails with:
AssertionError: Expected 100.94, got 100.93

Investigation notes:
The billing checkout coordinator in billing/service.py delegates monetary rounding to the shared currency rounding policy.
Due to floor truncation in the rounding policy rather than standard financial rounding, invoices are consistently under-billed by 1 cent on fractional totals.
Fix the monetary rounding precision policy to round to the nearest cent (half-up) so invoices settle accurately.
Preserve all existing method signatures and return types.
